doc: The baseline of a large answer: about 4 MB from the fake backend, decoded by the front, checked against the method's result type and written to the client, 10 times (--perf records every sample, no budget). The vehicle is env/set, the one method the backend still serves (agents/get, the transcript snapshot this row first measured, is the hub's own since agent system part 1): an applied list holding one 4 MB name.
